recent_reviews.body: My medication did not come in my package. I was extremely worried. I messaged customer support and they called back and handed the situation. UPS on the other hand was of no help. But, Maximus expedited a new shipment so it would not interrupt my progress. I am glad I decided to go through Maximus for my TRT. They have always been there and answered any questions I've had. They are great and there customer service is outstanding.

recent_reviews.title: Issue resolved
recent_reviews.body: Had an issue with auto shipping and being unable to cancel on the website or through customer service, they eventually resolved the issue and made it right. My hope is in the future they make managing the timing and shipment of medicine and lab kits easier so nothing has to go through customer service ideally. As long they continue to stand by their product and customers I will consider them a potentially supplier in the future.
